title: Physicist Christopher Stubbs joins Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust
headline: Physicist Christopher Stubbs joins Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust
summary: Anthropic has appointed physicist Christopher Stubbs to its Long-Term Benefit Trust, a body responsible for overseeing the company's public benefit mission and advising on AI risks. The Trust holds the authority to appoint a majority of Anthropic's board members. Stubbs brings expertise in scientific research, national security, and the reproducibility of AI-assisted research to the role.
why_it_matters: The appointment highlights the role of independent oversight bodies in governing the long-term safety and societal impacts of frontier AI development.

quotes.text: The Trust exists to help us hold that balance over the long term. It has the authority to appoint a majority of Anthropic’s board, and Trustees advise the board and our leadership on critical decisions, particularly those involving risks and societal impacts of AI.
